brief: A three-storey tower: drawers on the bottom storey and open bins on the top storey.

requirements.evidence: Half-n bases stacked at 0,0 levels 0, 1 and 2 (piece:0,0,0;half-n, piece:0,0,1;half-n, piece:0,0,2;half-n), snapped together vertically.
Drawer drawer:0#0,0#cut fitted on the cut face of the level-0 half-n base.

requirements.requirement: Open bins on the top storey
requirements.evidence: Open bin bin:0,0,2~hex-bin-half-n-full dropped into the level-2 (top) cell, no lid/cover over it.

requirements.requirement: House rules: cap open faces and lock joints
requirements.evidence: capOpenFaces added 7 end caps; lockJoints applied with no warnings. Middle storey left as plain structure, as the brief specifies only drawers (bottom) and bins (top).

finish.summary: Single-column three-storey tower: half-n bases stacked at levels 0-2, a drawer on the cut face of the bottom storey, and an open full-depth bin in the top storey. Open faces capped and joints locked; check_build passes with meshClash clear and no issues.

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
